problem.title: Minimum Score By Changing Two Elements

approaches.title: Sort and compare candidate ranges
approaches.summary: Sort the values, then take the minimum range remaining after removing two elements from one of the three possible positions at the extremes.

revisions.shortChangeSummary: Sorts the array and compares the three candidate ranges.

approaches.title: Track the three smallest and largest values
approaches.summary: Scan once to maintain the three smallest and three largest values, then compare the same three candidate ranges without sorting.

revisions.shortChangeSummary: Replaces sorting with a one-pass scan that tracks the three smallest and largest values.
